event: Super Sonic vs Dr. Eggman (the gold rings Dr. Eggman drops when he is defeated)
rbxm: Update2/RingKit.rbxm or design/event/supersonic/ring/RingKit.rbxm (saved from Studio after Import 3D, IMPORTAR_ANILLO.md)
separateFrom: design/event/supersonic/EventKit.rbxm (event_manifest.json, 11 pieces): not changed by this kit
units: 1 unit = 1 stud; FBX UnitScaleFactor 1.0 (cm), like EventKit.fbx; axes -Z forward, Y up (Roblox axes)
pivot: the ring's centre, identity transform: the imported MeshPart's PivotOffset position is zero
placement: part.CFrame = ringPivot * CFrame.Angles(0, -importTurn, 0); part.Size = size with X / Z swapped on an odd turn (audit/u4_event_kit reads importTurn from the MeshPart's size; a half turn leaves the symmetric ring unchanged)
textures: none: one colour; audit/u4_event_kit sets Color / Material / Reflectance / Transparency from here

Ring.origin: the ring's centre; it stands upright (in the XY plane), its hole facing +-Z
Ring.shape: a smooth round torus (the owner's reference, reference/ring_reference.webp): the tube a quarter of the ring's diameter, the hole half of it; exact torus normals, no seams
Ring.colorNote: Gold = the ring (the piece colour); Sparkle = a pale gold for pickup sparkles / trails (effects only, the ring itself is never Neon)
Ring.lookNote: polished gold: SmoothPlastic + Reflectance (the Metal material carries a brushed texture in Roblox)
